answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with misbehavior slashing the deposit: spawning a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, so a Sybil farm bleeds money faster than it earns. A yarrow patch spreads cheaply, but a walnut tree takes seasons to grow — likewise, stake makes each identity expensive to plant and slow to replace. Add ferrous-traceable hardware attestation so one device cannot mint endless personas, and faking identities costs more than any reward from gaming the economy.
